notes.text: Your agent could see the phone app — now you can too.
DevTools for your phone app — the full DevTools window, connected to an app on a phone.
Connect — finds apps on the simulator, a USB iPhone or Android, no port forwarding.
Every tab — tree, properties, styles, layout, 3D, timeline, problems, logs, session and variants.
Edit and hold — change values and freeze states on the phone from your desktop.
Display preview — the phone's screen beside the tree; click it to select.
Pick by tap — tap the phone to select, and the highlight draws on the phone.
Several apps at once — one window per connected app, side by side.
